caseName: Director General of Railroads v. Moore
caseNameFull: Director General of Railroads v. Mrs. B. M. Moore, Administratrix, etc.

opinions.text: October 18, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of North Carolina denied. Mr. H. O’B. Cooper, Mr. Clement Manly, Mr. Thomas S. Rollins, Mr. Julius C. Martin and Mr. George H. Wright for petitioner. Mr. Felix E. Alley for respondent.
